theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_orient_fixed
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U O : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → R.Represents T → DifferentiableOn ℝ f O → (∀ y ∈ T.support ∩ O, f y = y) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ O)), f x = x ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x (α.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) = R.orient x α
